# Google Apps Script Engineering
Inspect `Backend/Code.js` and `TestMode/Backend/` for existing contracts. Validate every client parameter, authorize actions server-side, preserve response shapes, and handle transient lock/quota failures. Keep secrets in Script Properties. Never deploy or test against production resources. QR algorithms and secret handling remain protected.
